Poem:
Bird watching, what a blast!
Pigeons perched on my head so fast,
A crow stole my sandwich, oh woe!
Sparrows mistook my hair for a cozy château.

A duck landed on my shoe with a quack,
Creating a scene, what a makeshift track!
Amidst the chaos, an eagle soared high,
Nature's wonder in the sky.

Bird watching full of laughter and fun,
Even with mishaps, it can't be undone.
So grab your binoculars, come with glee,
And join the adventure, let's bird watch with glee!
